name: sphener
description: Sphener (Fall from Heaven), an angel with short spiky golden hair and a young face, two big white feathered wings raised high behind his shoulders, polished silver-white plate armour with gold trim (pauldrons, gauntlets, knee guards and sabatons), a long white tabard with a gold border hanging from a gold belt, a long straight steel sword with a gold crossguard held upright in his RIGHT hand, and a white kite shield with a gold sun-cross on his LEFT arm
hands: the sword stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the white kite shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.5: follow-through: the blade carries on down until its tip nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, golden hair and white wings swept back

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, the white wings flaring, both arms jerk outward (the white kite shield flung out to the right, sword arm thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, sword dipping, the white kite shield still held out, wings half folded

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back toward the upper-right, sword arm flung up, the white kite shield drooping, wings flaring
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the sword slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the white wings crumpling
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, his white wings spread flat on the ground under him; the sword lies on the ground at the lower-left; the white kite shield lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the wings settle, the kite shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, white wings limp on the ground, the sword and the white kite shield on the ground beside him
